author: Amaya Norman
title: Victoria city council discusses firefighter petition for civil service and collective bargaining - NewsBreak
text:
By Amaya Norman ,
6 hours ago VICTORIA, Texas — Public safety, the city budget, and new community programs were all on the agenda at Tuesday night’s Victoria City Council meeting.
But the main focus was on the Victoria Fire Department and its push for civil service and collective bargaining rights.
Back in April, the Victoria Firefighter’s Association petitioned the city to adopt Texas laws that would establish civil service for the department. Those laws would set clear guidelines for hiring, promotions, and disciplinary actions within the fire department.
In addition, adopting collective bargaining would allow firefighters to negotiate directly with the city on key issues such as pay, benefits, and working conditions giving them a stronger voice in decisions that impact their jobs and safety.
Tuesday’s presentation outlined how civil service law and collective bargaining could affect city operations and the fire department’s structure.
Voters will ultimately decide whether to adopt the measures when they head to the polls on Nov. 4.
